decision_rule.reject_as_standalone_factor: Out-of-sample mean RankIC <= 0 OR mean Q5-Q1 return <= 0.
decision_rule.candidate_not_confirmed: Both directions are positive, but at least one of RankIC and Q5-Q1 does not pass the 5% significance threshold.
decision_rule.confirmed_standalone_candidate: Both directions are positive, both p-values < 0.05, and positive RankIC ratio >= 55%.

important_restriction: The decision log does not alter factor definitions, parameters or future composite weights.
reference_factor_rule: Vendor ROA and vendor ROIC are reference benchmarks and are not directly eligible for the future composite.
